description:
The mod manager for the Outer Wilds Mod Loader

Install and manage mods for the game Outer Wilds
Core Changes
- Update Dependencies
GUI Changes
- Added light theme, by default the manager will now follow your system preference
- Support for aarch64 builds (resolves #1291)
- Display prerelease option on local mods tab (resolves #1290)
- Fixed the AUR package depending on the wrong version of soup (resolves #1292)
